messages:
arjun: Heads-up — got a request from analytics to run a big telemetry recompute for the last 7 days. They want faster turnaround on P0 subsets but are fine for lower priority accounts to run on cheaper infra. How do we want to route these backfills?

maria: Can we use the existing backfill queue but add a priority tag? we already have priority buckets in the orchestration layer. low/normal/high.

devon: Priority tags are fine, but we need to ensure dedupe/idempotency. If the recompute job restarts on a different shard we don't want double-writes. Recommend adding a recompute_run_id and tracking last_applied_offset per-shard.

kaori: Also need console visibility. PMs want to see progress per-priority lane and an "estimated completion". Right now the console only shows running jobs count, not per-run ETA.

sam: For routing: send priority=high to the latency cluster (gpu-pool-fast) and priority=low to coldpool (cpu-cpu-economy). But we should cap high to avoid starving live inference. propose: high cap 25% of fast pool, low goes to coldpool with burst policy.

arjun: That sounds reasonable. Who owns the quotas change? We need quota checks in the API so client can't accidentally submit huge high-priority runs.

maria: I can add an api-level check: reject submit if requested_high_tokens + current_high_tokens > team_quota_high. Will return 429 with a structured body.

devon: We also need a backfill routing policy that understands model-compatibility. Some recomputes touch embeddings which require gpu nodes. Rule: if job.requires_gpu -> ignore low lane, force medium/high.

kaori: UX note: in the Console job creation flow add a toggle: [ ] Priority lane (High / Medium / Low) and a tooltip: "High uses fast infra and counts against High quota." Show estimated cost delta.

sam: API snippet for new param: 

```bash
curl -X POST "$API_URL/backfills" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"query":"...","priority":"high","recompute_run_id":"rr-2026-03-20-01","requires_gpu":false}'
```

sam: Response example: 429 payload: `\{"error\":\"quota_exceeded\", \"policy\":\"high_quota\", \"retry_after_seconds\":3600\}`

maria: We'll need to extend the quotas table in the DB: team_id, priority_level, tokens_committed, tokens_used, window_start. I can do a short migration.

devon: Backfill workers should read recompute_run_id for dedupe, and we should add `last_committed_sequence` to the aggregates table to detect partial progress and resume.

kaori: Dashboard metrics request: recompute.jobs.started, recompute.jobs.completed, recompute.tokens_consumed_by_priority, recompute.estimated_completion_seconds. We should tag metrics by priority and region.

arjun: Ops question — if we route low priority to coldpool, do we need eviction/fallback if coldpool saturates? We shouldn't block the job submission because it can sit queued.

sam: Keep submission allowed but return estimated start time. When coldpool saturates, we can re-route oldest low jobs to a delayed queue or offer explicit "accelerate" action that consumes high quota.

maria: I'll implement the API validation + 429 shape. Can someone take the Console change? @kaori?

kaori: I'll take the Console mock and add the metric tiles. Also will add a small rollout: start with "show only" for internal teams behind a feature flag.

devon: I can do the worker changes and DB columns. I'll add tests for idempotency.

arjun: Nice. Timeline? we ideally want a pilot this week for analytics team. realistic?

maria: API + quota checks — 2 days.

devon: Worker changes + db migration — 3 days, but can run in parallel. Need a migration window for the new column back-pop.

kaori: Console mock + flag — 2 days.

sam: I'll draft the routing policy config and update the orchestration rules. 1 day.

ops-bot: Scheduled job "telemetry-recompute-rr-2026-03-20-01" started by analytics at 2119004385

arjun: OK let's sync tomorrow 10am. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

maria: cc @platform-sre — please watch the migration window and quota table perf.

devon: one last note: add a small postback from workers with `progress_pct` so Console can show live progress without heavy telemetry.

kaori: agreed. we'll add a small websocket feed for realtime updates behind the feature flag.

arjun: End.
